title: Events in Portugal, by place
about: Why this source does or does not have a problem, from its own request log (data/<id>/reads.json) and git. Regenerated at each wake.

requests.name: tavira-robots
requests.meaning: no robots.txt: the site publishes no rules (not a failure)

copies.note: collect/lib.mjs says vaults/ is meant to stay out of git, but 0 files of this source are tracked in git today (earlier commits); the sgit vault holds the full history. Dinis has not yet ruled on the vaults/ question.

held.note: Dates are the items' own dates (forecast sources hold future dates). per_day lists up to the 60 newest days. null where the items carry no date.

cadence_advice.line: The data changed on 57 of 58 reads over 9 days: nearly every read finds new data, so it changes at least as often as it is read and reading more than twice a day would catch more states. Whether the pages that use it need them is for their owners to say.
cadence_advice.basis: suggestion derived from 58 runs in data/<id>/reads.json (a run counts as changed when any request returned different bytes than the run before); the source's own cadence on the card is every 6 hours; runs before 21 Nov were hourly

schedule_times.note: Lisbon is UTC+0 from late October to late March, so these are also 07:03 and 18:03 UTC then; one hour earlier in UTC in summer.

own_page_copy_note: not taken: a copy or screenshot of the publisher's page needs a rights ruling from cl-6.rights; source_home links to the page itself
